transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I guess I’ve just been having a harder time lately. Since my sister and her baby moved back home, things at the house feel kind of tense, and I’ve been more on edge than normal. I snap over small stuff, then I go to class or the shop already worn out.

I’m still getting through things, mostly, but I’ve missed a couple deadlines and I backed out of helping with a theater set because I couldn’t really keep everything straight.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?

Yeah… I think so. Since my sister and the baby moved back home, I’ve just been more on edge. I get irritated over small things, and then I’m already kind of drained when I get to class or the shop. It’s not like I’m falling apart, but I’ve missed a couple deadlines and backed out of helping with a theater set because I couldn’t keep everything straight.
Have you been avoiding any activities or places because of your anxiety?

Not really places, I guess. I’m still going to class and work. I did stop helping with the community theater set, though… I just couldn’t keep up with everything. And I’ve turned in a couple assignments late.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?

A little, yeah. I wouldn’t say I’m sad all the time, but since my sister and the baby moved back home I’ve felt more down and drained than usual. I still get through class and work, mostly… just not as well as before.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or urges that you can't get out of your head?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I worry about stuff, but not like thoughts or urges I can’t get out of my head.
Do you have any repetitive behaviors that you feel compelled to do?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed anything like that.
How long have you been feeling this way since your sister and her baby moved back home?
About a month, I guess. Since they moved back into the house.
How would you rate your level of anxiety on a scale from 1 to 10, with 1 being minimal and 10 being overwhelming?
Maybe like a 4 or 5. It’s not overwhelming… I’m still getting by. I’ve just been more on edge since my sister and the baby moved back in, and I get drained easier.
Have you been having any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
Not really. I mean, I think about stuff sometimes, but not like... thoughts repeating over and over. I haven’t really noticed that.
Do you find yourself ruminating or obsessing over specific thoughts or worries?
No… I don’t think so. I worry some, but I wouldn’t say I obsess over anything.
Are there any social situations that you've been avoiding because you feel anxious or uncomfortable?
Not really. I mean… I haven’t been avoiding people or anything because of anxiety. I might keep to myself sometimes, but not because I’m scared of social stuff.
Have you been putting off or procrastinating on tasks because of feeling anxious or overwhelmed?

Yeah… a little, I guess. I’m still going to class and work, but I’ve turned in a couple assignments late. And I had to drop this community theater set project because I just couldn’t really keep up with everything.
Have you been avoiding doing anything at home because you feel anxious or overwhelmed since your sister and her baby moved in?

Yeah… kind of. Not like I’m hiding in my room all day, but since they moved in I’ve been more tense at home. I’ll put off chores or stuff I should do because I’m already irritated or drained, and then it kind of carries into class and the shop. I’m still doing what I have to, mostly, but I’ve let a couple deadlines slip and dropped that theater set thing because I couldn’t keep it all straight.
Have you been experiencing any intrusive thoughts or images that recur and cause you distress?
No… I don’t think so. Not like images or thoughts that keep coming back and really mess with me.
Have you been avoiding any specific tasks or activities outside of home because you feel anxious?

Yeah… I guess mostly school stuff. I’m still going to class and work, but I’ve turned in a couple assignments late. And I stopped doing the community theater set project because I just couldn’t keep up with everything.
Have you been experiencing any compulsions to perform specific rituals or behaviors?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not doing any rituals or anything like that.
Have you been having any thoughts that you feel are intrusive or unwanted?
Not really… I mean, I get stressed thinking about stuff, but I wouldn’t call it intrusive or unwanted like that.
Have you been having any thoughts that you try to suppress or get rid of?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I try not to dwell on stuff sometimes, but not like I’m fighting off thoughts or anything.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your daily routine or overall functioning since you started feeling this way?

A little, yeah. I’m still going to class and work, but I’ve been slipping some… turned in a couple assignments late. And I had to drop this community theater set project because I just couldn’t keep up with everything.
Are you avoiding any social interactions because you feel anxious?
Not really. I mean, I might keep to myself a little more sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m avoiding people because I’m anxious.
